reason_added_after_primary: The preregistered result showed a small positive aggregate cross-regime penalty. These checks were fixed before inspecting any seed, ridge, normalization, or regime-swap outcomes to test high-dimensional overfitting and preprocessing sensitivity. They do not replace or redefine the primary endpoint.

data_contract.selection: Reuse the exact 816 ordered item IDs selected by parent protocol devbunova_wrapper_scale_v1.
data_contract.paired_unit: full item_id across model and regime only
data_contract.layer_semantics: stored zero-based index only; extraction hook semantics undocumented

fixed_endpoint.probe: same diagonal LDA as parent protocol

checks.paired_regime_swap_definition: For each binary task, independently swap raw and template representations within each item with probability 0.5, preserving item, label, model, and marginal regime sizes; refit and evaluate the fixed probe/folds.
checks.permutation_p_value: (1 + count(null aggregate penalty >= observed aggregate penalty)) / (1 + n_permutations)

robustness_rule.robust_positive: At q=0.75, the aggregate of the two purpose tasks is positive for every model under every ridge and normalization, the median across fold seeds is positive for every model, and the all-model observed aggregate exceeds the 97.5th percentile of the paired regime-swap null.
robustness_rule.mixed: Any sign or null criterion fails; report the complete sensitivity matrix and do not use a robust-positive headline.
robustness_rule.invalid: Parent item hash, parent result hash, model/regime IDs, selected rows, or fixed layer differs.
